about_the_game:
Ani Idle is a Fantasy RPG with an Idle-like playstyle. Jump into a short adventure and try to kill all the enemies and clear all the dungeons.

While not fighting, you might feel like taking a rest, do some quests or craft your gear to make it more powerful.

Your Character:

You will have different stats like attributes (used for quests), regeneration, crit chance, chance for DoTs or just raw damage. Damage types include physical, fire, ice and lightning - the same goes for your resistances.

Find the best combinations to fight your enemies, because they have the same kind of stats.

Classes:

Depending on your weapon you will have one of five classes and each class has their own skill you can use in combat.

Fight:

Start with some low-level slimes, like every good adventurer does. Soon you will kill more dangerous enemies and loot their gear to make it yours. Kill enough of them to also level up and become stronger and stronger.

Dungeons:

When you are ready, start exploring dungeons, that will contain several enemies in a row. This is the only place, where you cannot flee, so be prepared!

Quests:

Good adventurers will have to do some quests from time to time. Explore weird places, help some people (or not) and gather some loot here as well. Each quest will let you choose between three options and sometimes they just have random outcomes and could also depend on your attributes.

Rest:

You deserve it!

Inventory:

Sort and check your precious loot. Equip your gear or see what kind of delicious consumables you might find.

Crafting:

If you have already found some crafting crystals, this is your place to be! Use them to reroll your gear, try to make it the best you currently need.

Achievements:

Of course there are Achievements to collect and hunt! Some might be easy, but others might need some more research. Check the menu for some advice on how to get them.

Ani Idle is the very first game I developed. It started as a hobby and grew into something special. I am proud to have made it this far and hope you will like my little Idle-like RPG adventure game as much as I do.
